card.line: El-bethel is the name Jacob gave to the place at Luz, also called Bethel, where he built an altar because God had revealed Himself to him.

moments.title: Jacob builds an altar
moments.text: Jacob and his household arrived at Luz, also called Bethel, in Canaan. There Jacob built an altar and named the place El-bethel, because God had revealed Himself to him there as he fled from his brother.

moments.title: God renames Jacob Israel
moments.text: After Jacob returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him. God told him his name would now be Israel, and promised him a nation, kings, and the land given to Abraham and Isaac.
